t: Said as he went into the bow at night
a: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي وَبَصَرِي وَمُخِّي وَعَظْمِي وَعَصَبِي
p: Allāhumma laka rakaʿtu wa bika āmantu wa laka aslamtu, khashaʿa laka samʿī wa baṣarī wa mukhkhī wa ʿaẓmī wa ʿaṣabī.
m: O Allah, to You I have bowed, in You I have believed, to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones and nerves are humbled before You.
